A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a permit the society renews after catalogue audits is fresh per account, and the tundra is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the cipher of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
